authority_policy: Official help/news first. Stable mechanics and rotating current data remain separate. Changed source prose requires human review before normalized facts change.

sources.title: How can I increase a Pokémon’s Mega Level?

domains.label: Inventory search operators and tags
normalized_facts: Official search documentation includes Dynamax, Gigantamax, Fusion and Hyper Training terms.
Boolean AND/OR/exclusion and numeric range forms are documented.

domains.label: IV, appraisal, CP and levels
normalized_facts: Appraisal star and individual Attack/Defense/HP search bands are documented.

domains.label: Evolution and special requirements
normalized_facts: Inventory search exposes evolve, evolvenew, evolvequest and tradeevolve, but the complete per-species requirement registry is not yet implemented.

domains.label: Moves, TMs, Elite TMs and exclusive moves
normalized_facts: Stable move pools are separate from current acquisition availability.

domains.label: Shadow, Purified, Frustration and Return
normalized_facts: Purification and Frustration are treated as consequential mechanics requiring explicit review.

domains.label: Mega, Primal and Super Max Level
normalized_facts: Super Max Level is distinct from ordinary Mega Level progression and requires Mega Energy investment.

domains.label: Dynamax, Gigantamax, Max Moves and Max Particles
normalized_facts: Dynamax Max Attack follows Fast Attack type; Gigantamax may use unique Max Moves.
Trading a Max Pokémon resets Max Move progress and Gigantamax trades are Special Trades.
At least one Max Pokémon must remain in storage before transfer/trade of another Max Pokémon.

domains.label: Hyper Training and Bottle Caps
normalized_facts: Good Buddy or higher is required before Hyper Training.
Shadow and existing 4-star Pokémon are ineligible.
Hyper Training can last at most one year after a Bottle Cap is used and trained Pokémon cannot be sent to HOME.

domains.label: Fusion
normalized_facts: Fusion is represented in the official inventory-search contract; detailed partner/resource rules still require a dedicated reviewed registry.

domains.label: Buddy mechanics
normalized_facts: Buddy level is represented in inventory search; Hyper Training progress requires the Pokémon to be the active buddy.

domains.label: Raids, Shadow raids and Party Power
GO Battle League and cup mechanics
Trading and Lucky mechanics
normalized_facts: Max-specific trade consequences are reviewed; the complete general/Lucky trade registry remains partial.

domains.label: Pokémon HOME transfer restrictions
normalized_facts: Hyper Trained Pokémon cannot be sent to HOME; Gigantamax Pokémon cannot be sent to HOME; Dynamax Pokémon sent to HOME do not retain Max Moves.
